title: Prove the sharp two-plane COPY floor for arbitrary scalar factorizations
body:
Proves sharp COPY mass 8 for any finite scalar factorization on two matched planes, over every coefficient field. This closes the arbitrary cofactor-cancellation and overcomplete gaps in #3990/#3997 using a rank proof, not a larger search. Disjoint pair-local decoders therefore retain COPY >=224; their inherited optimistic complete budget is 293/292 >1. **No new κ.**

Base: `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` (canonical main, priority 7; OS seed 27).
Published commit: `c2f6264c2952c983bb445dc5ae00c6a2adf28649`. Its complete Git tree matches the tested contribution.

[Proof, exact certificate, source pins and validation](https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/c2f6264c2952c983bb445dc5ae00c6a2adf28649/research/two-plane-copy-floor)
Runtime SHA256 pins:
- selected archive: `f1da80610bf33c58527f18ad63b4350d0b864e1d4486141ee17ac9bed4d529d6`
- extracted member: `c5916ff312678f12aba403847643fbbc29f643acec60bdf836fa56cd3e8251fa`
- matching: `4fd648f7b5178bff5441bf364d58234b7bc1a43b924bc6da03013c948f1473b1`

Reproduce (Python 3.12, stdlib):
`python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-plane-copy-floor`
Expected: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`.

Executed: all 1,540 pairs/13,860 inequalities; 682 small binary blocks; exact rational, complex and six-term fixtures; normal/-O replay; separate image-set and shortest-path checker for all five tariff classes. Seven internal rejection controls, an independently underpriced optimum (8 ->6), and ten external receipt/source-corruption runs passed. Committed-byte/source-history, export/integrity and read-only Git-free checks passed.

Scope: whole-plane closures, scalar rank-one messages, separate additive COPY billing, fixed pair-local coverage. A six-term control improves concave COPY-only cost at equal mass; it still fails the complete budget. Cross-pair sharing, changed coverage/readers, native source access, restoration, hosting and all-size/outer obligations remain open. Finite checks do not constitute a formal proof of the full theorem. Selected frontier and upstream/ unchanged; no hosted-CI claim.

Attribution: @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit Gonzalo Mier (#3990/#3997), Cinna Davis, Adam Gall, Jeremy Diviney, ctoth/Philippe Van Velzen, Nick Petalas and the retained supplier lineage. Related #3383/#3489/#3505 have different scopes; exact comparison and full credit are in the package. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.
